title: Validate unlinked sales-return and purchase-return draft line shape and live master references
description: Stage 3 verified write-validation gap in the returns-to-inventory operational link, the same defect class repaired for sales orders and purchase orders (ERP-422/ERP-426/ERP-427) and for the sibling stock adjustment draft. src/ERP.Api/Controllers/SalesReturnController.cs:200-241 Create and :244+ Update, and src/ERP.Api/Controllers/PurchaseReturnController.cs:183-205 Create and :207+ Update, rely for detail validation on SalesReturnSourceRules.ValidateLinkAsync and PurchaseReturnSourceRules.ValidateLinkAsync, but src/ERP.Application/Services/SalesReturnSourceRules.cs:223-234 delegates to ResolveLinkAsync whose first statement is that a null SourceStockOutId returns null (:146), and src/ERP.Application/Services/PurchaseReturnSourceRules.cs:180 and :105 do the same for a null SourceStockInId. A draft that is explicitly unlinked keeps the historical no-source semantics and therefore reaches persistence with no line-shape or live-master validation at all: an empty effective detail list, a zero, negative or EF-unrepresentable Quantity, a missing, soft-deleted or disabled ProductId, a non-positive or soft-deleted or disabled WarehouseId and a negative or EF-unrepresentable UnitPrice are all accepted. Approve rejects the empty details and a non-positive quantity only after the malformed draft is stored and page-visible (SalesReturnController :345-346 and :356-357; PurchaseReturnController :297-298 and :309-310). Add a shared draft guard used by both return controllers on create and update, whatever the source link, so that shape and live-master references are rejected before the document number is consumed and before any detail write, while the explicit link, snapshot, customer or upstream scope, source lock ordering, serializable transactions, cost resolution, reversal semantics and StockMovements ledger stay unchanged. No new table, column, index or menu. Preserve supported empty draft headers if established; all explicit effective lines require valid positive bounded quantities and nonnegative representable prices/costs. Submit/approval requires nonempty valid lines. Validate calculated line and header amounts against real EF precision/overflow before numbering or writes, not merely each factor separately. Preserve supported repeated product lines and cumulative quantity semantics, do not introduce an arbitrary uniqueness rule. Preserve current business permissions and actor/customer scope; no new grants. Adapt all affected original fixtures with real enabled identities and existing menus/master rows, never remove business assertions or retain null-context/provider/test exceptions. Full original failure logs retained. Explicit test output/TRX/results directories must be .ai/logs/<task> only, never repository-root TestResults. SQL must use exactly (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with Integrated Security and a fresh GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject wrong/existing targets before access, never drop/reset. Safe Release restore/build with analyzers and warnings-as-errors, full units and relevant genuine isolated SQL validation; no whole-stage acceptance or production access. Related original source-selection, loading-cancellation and return-cancellation isolated SQL fixtures that call these controllers are explicitly authorized for genuine master/identity fixture adaptation only. Preserve all original inventory quantity, movement/cancellation, source ownership and concurrency assertions. Include relevant related SQL regressions before completion; do not weaken business validators, authorize production access or change transaction contracts.
acceptance_criteria: Create and update on /api/inventory/sales-returns and /api/inventory/purchase-returns reject, before consuming a document number and before any SalesReturn or PurchaseReturn detail write, a detail with a non-positive or EF-unrepresentable Quantity, a detail with a negative or EF-unrepresentable UnitPrice, a detail whose ProductId is missing or does not exist or is soft-deleted or disabled, a non-positive WarehouseId, and a warehouse that does not exist or is soft-deleted or disabled, independently of whether the document is explicitly linked to a source stock-out or stock-in, using the existing controlled validation errors with zero persisted change; explicit-source link, snapshot, customer-scope and cumulative return-capacity semantics are unchanged.

Retain every existing return boundary: the existing sales-return and purchase-return menu gate, customer or upstream scope, source row-lock ordering, serializable transactions, cost resolution, reversal semantics and StockMovements ledger stay unchanged, and approve and unaudit continue to revalidate persisted quantities and live master data; no new table, column, index, menu, grant or permission.

Add genuine unit tests and isolated SQL controller tests covering create and update for linked and unlinked returns with permitted empty draft headers and rejected empty commitments, zero and negative quantity, negative unit price, unrepresentable quantity and price, missing, deleted and disabled product, missing, zero, deleted and disabled warehouse and the permitted flow, asserting zero return-document, detail, StockMovement and document-number change on every rejection; existing SalesReturnSourceTests, SalesReturnSourceSelectionTests, PurchaseReturnSourceTests, PurchaseReturnSourceSelectionTests and ReturnSourceCancellationTests contracts stay green.

Keep the safe Release build with analyzers and warnings-as-errors and the full existing ERP.UnitTests suite green, run genuine SQL only on the isolated localdb NEWERP_AutoAcceptance instance with Integrated Security and a fresh GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database that is never dropped or reset, and claim no whole-stage acceptance from a build alone.

Preserve currently supported empty draft headers and repeated product lines; validate every explicitly supplied effective line, and require nonempty valid lines before submit or approval. Numeric validation includes calculated line/header representability and overflow after existing unit normalization. Rejected calls consume no number and change no document/detail/inventory/source rows.
implementation_evidence: src/ERP.Api/Controllers/SalesReturnController.cs:200-241 Create (ValidateLinkAsync at :222) and :244+ Update rely on SalesReturnSourceRules.ValidateLinkAsync; src/ERP.Application/Services/SalesReturnSourceRules.cs:223-234 delegates to ResolveLinkAsync whose early return for a null SourceStockOutId is at :146; src/ERP.Api/Controllers/PurchaseReturnController.cs:183-205 Create (ValidateLinkAsync at :194) and :207+ Update do the same with src/ERP.Application/Services/PurchaseReturnSourceRules.cs:180 and :105; so an explicitly unlinked draft persists an empty detail list, zero or negative quantity, negative unit price, missing or disabled product and missing or disabled warehouse unchecked; Approve rejects the empty details and the non-positive quantity only later (SalesReturnController :345-346 and :356-357; PurchaseReturnController :297-298 and :309-310); an exact search of .ai/tasks returns no task adding unlinked draft validation to the return controllers.
